Precondition: Signup page is open and the email is not already registered
Test Steps: 1. Open the Signup page 2. Fill Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Password and Confirm Password 3. Select a role 4. Click Signup
Expected Result: Account is created and the OTP verification screen opens
Actual Result: Account was created and the OTP screen opened as expected

Test Steps: 1. Leave Full Name blank 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Select a role 4. Click Signup
Test Data: fullname blank, all other fields valid
Expected Result: A validation message naming the Full Name field
Actual Result: Message displayed: Please enter your full name

Test Steps: 1. Leave Email blank 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Test Data: email blank, all other fields valid
Expected Result: A validation message naming the Email field
Actual Result: Message displayed: Please enter your email

Test Steps: 1. Leave Phone Number blank 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Test Data: phoneNumber blank, all other fields valid
Expected Result: A validation message naming the Phone Number field
Actual Result: Message displayed: Please enter your phone number

Test Steps: 1. Leave Password blank 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Test Data: password blank, all other fields valid
Expected Result: A validation message naming the Password field
Actual Result: Message displayed: Please enter the password

Test Steps: 1. Fill every field correctly 2. Do not select Jobseeker or Recruiter 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: A validation message asking the user to select a role
Actual Result: Message displayed: Please select the role

Test Steps: 1. Enter Aavash123 in Full Name 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Select a role 4. Click Signup 5. Check whether the account was created
Expected Result: Rejected with a message that a name must not contain numbers
Actual Result: Registration completed successfully. Aavash123 was accepted as a valid name and the account was created
Remarks: Full Name accepts digits. Logged as D-01.

Test Steps: 1. Enter 1234567890 in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Rejected with a message about the phone number prefix
Actual Result: Message displayed: Phone number must start with 98

Test Steps: 1. Enter 987 in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Rejected with a message about the required length
Actual Result: Message displayed: Phone number must be 10 digits

Test Scenario: Password shorter than the minimum length
Test Steps: 1. Enter Pas@1 in Password and Confirm Password 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a message explaining the minimum password length
Actual Result: Message displayed: Password must be at lease 6 digits with at least  one special character , one capital letter and must be one number.
Remarks: The password rule works, but the message has spelling and wording errors. Logged as D-02.

Test Scenario: Password and Confirm Password do not match
Test Steps: 1. Enter Pass@1234 in Password 2. Enter Pass@4321 in Confirm Password 3. Fill every other field correctly 4. Click Signup
Expected Result: Rejected with a mismatch message
Actual Result: Message displayed: Password and confirm password did not match

Test Scenario: Register with an email that is already registered
Precondition: An account already exists with the email used
Test Steps: 1. Fill the form using an already registered email 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Rejected with a message that the email is already registered
Actual Result: Message displayed: Mail is registered previously

Test Steps: 1. Enter 9741234567 in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Accepted, because 97 is a valid Nepali mobile prefix
Actual Result: Message displayed: Phone number must start with 98
Remarks: A valid Nepali mobile number beginning with 97 is rejected. Logged as D-03.

Test Steps: 1. Enter 98123456789 in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Either the field stops at 10 digits or a length message is shown
Actual Result: Message displayed : Phone number must be 10 digits .

Test Steps: 1. Enter 9812345678 in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Accepted and registration proceeds
Actual Result: Account was created and the OTP screen opened as expected

Test Scenario: Letters entered in the Phone Number field
Test Steps: 1. Type abcdefghij in Phone Number 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Letters are not accepted, or a validation message is shown
Actual Result: Message displayed: Phone number must start with 98
Remarks: The input is rejected, but the prefix message does not explain that letters are invalid. Consider logging a separate message-quality defect.

Test Steps: 1. Enter aavash@ in Email 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Rejected with an invalid email message
Actual Result: Message Displayed : Email must end with @gmail.com

Test Steps: 1. Enter aavash@#$ in Full Name 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Registration is rejected for unsupported name symbols
Actual Result: Registration completed successfully. aavash@#$ was accepted as a valid name and the account was created
Remarks: Full Name accepts unsupported symbols. Logged as D-04.

Test Scenario: Leading and trailing spaces in the email
Test Steps: 1. Enter the email with a space before and after 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Spaces are trimmed and registration succeeds
Actual Result: Account was created and the OTP screen opened as expected

Test Steps: 1. Type a password in the Password field 2. Observe the characters shown
Expected Result: Characters are shown as dots, never as plain text
Actual Result: Result : Characters are not shown

Test Scenario: Same email registered in a different letter case
Precondition: An account already exists with joshiaavash111@gmail.com
Test Steps: 1. Register using JOSHIAAVASH111@GMAIL.COM 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Treated as the same email and rejected as a duplicate
Actual Result: Message Displayed : Email is already used
Remarks: If this creates a second account, one person can hold two accounts on the same address

Test Scenario: Double click on the Signup button
Test Steps: 1. Fill the form correctly 2. Double click Signup quickly 3. Check how many accounts were created
Expected Result: Only one account is created
Actual Result: Result : Account created only once

Test Steps: 1. Fill every field correctly 2. Leave Confirm Password blank 3. Select a role 4. Click Signup
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a message naming Confirm Password
Actual Result: Result: Please enter confirm Password

Test Scenario: Password at the minimum valid length
Test Steps: 1. Enter a password containing exactly the stated minimum number of characters 2. Meet all character rules 3. Complete and submit the form
Expected Result: Registration proceeds when all password rules are satisfied
Actual Result: Message displayed: Password must be at lease 6 digits with at least one special character , one capital letter and must be one number.
Remarks: A password meeting the shown rules is rejected. Logged as D-05.

Test Steps: 1. Enter test@123 in Password and Confirm Password 2. Complete and submit the form
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a message requiring an uppercase letter
Actual Result: Account was created and the OTP screen opened as expected
Remarks: A password without an uppercase letter is accepted. Logged as D-06.

Test Steps: 1. Enter Test@abc in Password and Confirm Password 2. Complete and submit the form
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a message requiring a number
Actual Result: Message displayed: Password must be at lease 6 digits with at least one special character , one capital letter and must be one number.

Test Steps: 1. Enter Test1234 in Password and Confirm Password 2. Complete and submit the form
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a message requiring a special character
Actual Result: Message displayed: Password must be at lease 6 digits with at least one special character , one capital letter and must be one number.

Test Scenario: Register with a valid non-Gmail email
Precondition: Signup page is open and the email is not registered
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid non-Gmail email 2. Fill every other field correctly 3. Select a role 4. Click Signup
Expected Result: Registration succeeds because Outlook is a valid email provider
Actual Result: Message Displayed : Email must end with @gmail.com
Remarks: A valid Outlook address is rejected because it is not Gmail. Logged as D-07.
